name: create-frontend-design
description: Create a new UI direction only when no authoritative Design Contract covers the Work Unit.

# Create frontend design

Use only for `design_mode` `create` or `explore`. Must not be used as the
primary procedure under `conform` or `adapt`.

1. Confirm `design_mode` is create or explore and no authoritative mockup
   covers the Work Unit.
2. Ground the design in the approved brief without inventing users or goals.
3. Derive distinctive choices and a compact token system.
4. Search the design system inventory before creating components.
5. Build to the plan within explicit free zones.
6. Document rationale and mark inferences that need human validation.

If an authoritative mockup appears, stop and request a human decision — do not
compete with Design Authority. Prefer the legacy `frontend-design` skill for
aesthetic execution details once the brief is already approved.
